Time Turner
All grades · Time management

A plan for the week you actually have.

Time Turner helps learners see where their time goes. They map school, homework, sport, meals, chores and rest across their school’s 10-day timetable, add the tests and assessments coming up, and get a printable plan with tips built around the gaps it finds, from their own schedule and without AI.

Create a free account Sign in

Runs in any modern browser. Nothing to install.

What learners do

Built on the school timetable

Works with a 10-day cycle as well as the things that happen on the same day every week.

Assessments in view

Tests and assignments sit in the same plan as everything else.

Suggestions from the learner’s own week

Open time is spotted and suggested from their schedule, with no AI involved.

Print and share

Export a time-management plan to print or keep.

Questions

Who is it for?

Any learner who feels there is never enough time, and teachers or parents helping them build a routine.

Does it use AI?

No. The suggestions come from the learner’s own schedule.

How much does it cost?

Time Turner is one of thirteen tools on The Magic Lab. Start with a free account; full access to every tool is one plan, and schools can get a quote for all their learners and teachers.
